notes: Two isnads. Route one (group 1) ends at علقمة, who reports his own journey.

Route two (group 2) is written right after the first (rule 4), but it is an anecdote about Alqama's visit, not clearly the same saying. Its last link is Ibrahim, whose words open «قال ذهب علقمة». Alqama and Abu al-Darda in the story are scene only.

Open: Abu al-Darda says «وقد سمعتها من رسول الله» inside that anecdote. Whether he is a link after Ibrahim is not settled by the rules (rule 6), so he is not added. Rule 11 applies to two sayings, each with its own isnad.
The Qur'an recitation inside the story is quoted text, not a name.
